title: Machine learning models for predicting postoperative delirium after noncardiac surgery: A comparative study.
summary: XGBoost, logistic regression and SVM models predicted postoperative delirium after noncardiac surgery from perioperative patient variables, within the scope and limitations the paper states. The results are limited to the reported models and cohorts; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
